questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Then yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns of immediate hazards ahead. This sign tells you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign facing you, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells you that you must obey traffic laws. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two one-way roadways with a median or divider between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop. Look for pedestrians and other traffic. Only proceed when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, let traffic and pedestrians pass if they have the right-of-way, then proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a sharp change in road direction ahead. Slow down and prepare for a sharp turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming conditions. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be careful to avoid collisions and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and tell you what is ahead. Speed advisory plaques on these signs show the safe speed to use.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is reserved only for left-turning vehicles from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or to drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is moving in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road or driveway is not safe to enter from your direction. Turn around and take another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, move to another lane if it is safe to do so. This makes room for the entering vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the side shown by the arrow. There is a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead.
